critical_finding: MC-350 is a mandatory Judicial Council form for court-ordered competency evaluations. Its absence from Dr. Wiita's CST evaluation means: (1) the evaluation was not conducted within the court-prescribed framework; (2) no authentication path exists for the evaluation as a court-ordered document; (3) §1401 requires authentication before admission; (4) §1402 places the burden on the proponent to account for the missing mandatory form. The absence IS the finding.
